meta.name: advanced-skill-creator
meta.description: Advanced OpenClaw skill creation handler that executes the official 5-step research flow with comprehensive analysis and best practices. Ensures proper methodology when users request to create or modify OpenClaw/Moltbot/ClawDBot skills following official standards.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按官方流程创建或修改 OpenClaw 系列技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要按官方标准创建或修改 OpenClaw 系列技能。
copy.tagline_en: Create or modify OpenClaw series skills following official standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or modify OpenClaw series skills following official standards.

howto.what: 安装后，当你要创建或修改 OpenClaw、Moltbot、ClawDBot 技能时，它会自动执行官方 5 步研究流程：查阅文档、搜索公开技能、查找最佳实践、融合方案、输出完整文件。
howto.when: 当你提到“写一个触发”、“写skill”、“claw skill”、“openclaw skill”、“moltbot skill”、“创建技能”或“写一个让它...”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 写一个触发定时任务的技能
say.note: 它会执行5步流程，生成完整的技能文件。
它会搜索ClawHub上的相关技能并给出推荐方案。

say.text: 写一个让它自动回复的技能
say.note: 它会按官方标准创建带触发条件的技能。

howto.what_en: When installed, if you request to create or modify an OpenClaw, Moltbot, or ClawDBot skill, it automatically executes the official 5-step research flow: consult docs, search public skills, find best practices, fuse solutions, and output complete files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like '写一个触发', '写skill', 'claw skill', 'openclaw skill', 'moltbot skill', '创建技能', or '写一个让它...'.

say_en.text: Write a skill for scheduled tasks.
say_en.note: It runs the 5-step flow and generates complete skill files.
It searches ClawHub for relevant skills and recommends a solution.
It creates a skill with trigger conditions per official standards.
